name: Rigid Parametric Alignment
definition: A differentiable solver that estimates a 3D rigid transformation T ∈ SE(3) from correspondences by minimizing the reprojection error in a closed form using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD).
summary: Rigid Parametric Alignment computes the optimal 3D rigid transformation aligning point sets via Singular Value Decomposition, distinguishing itself from iterative methods by solving the problem in a single closed-form step.
